description: This header defines NEON-optimized functions for packing and unpacking IQ samples in various bit-width formats (9, 14, 16 bits) for resource blocks, including specific functions for big-endian packing and unpacking, utilizing ARM NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: pack_neon_register_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Reads eight 16-bit IQ values from input NEON register and packs them into 9 bytes in big-endian format.

methods.name: pack_prb_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Compresses 16-bit IQ values of a resource block into 9-bit big-endian format and stores in buffer.

methods.name: pack_neon_register_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Reads eight 16-bit IQ values and packs them into 14 bytes in big-endian format.

methods.name: pack_prb_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Compresses IQ values into 14-bit big-endian format for a resource block.

methods.name: pack_prb_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Compresses IQ values into 16-bit big-endian format for a resource block.

methods.name: unpack_prb_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 9-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 14-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Unpacks 16-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_compressed_14bit_values
methods.description: Converts a NEON register containing 14-bit compressed data into 8 16-bit IQ samples.

methods.name: unpack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatches to specific unpacking functions based on IQ width.

methods.name: iq_width_packing_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given IQ bit width (9, 14, 16) is supported by the NEON packing/unpacking functions.
